verdict.rationale: Cekura's evidence shows the reverse pattern: external AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot) can drive Cekura via its MCP server, Skills plugin, CLI and SDK (cekura-docs-2, cekura-docs-3, cekura-docs-26, cekura-gh-1, cekura-probe-4/5). There is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant embedded inside the Cekura product itself that a user delegates tasks to (e.g., an in-app chat/copilot); the closest mention is an automated fix-suggestion pipeline (cekura-docs-21) which is a scripted evaluation flow, not a conversational assistant a user delegates to.
